p: Being inside The Centre makes this Admiral a quick, under-cover stop, but bear in mind it's an adult gaming centre and 18+ only, so anyone under that age will be carrying on round the shops without you.

Livingston grew up as one of Scotland's post-war new towns, and The Centre links straight through to Livingston Designer Outlet, so there's a fair bit of walking to be done if you're after a bargain. When you've had enough of shops, Almondvale Park runs alongside the River Almond close by for a gentler stroll. Livingston FC play just a few minutes away at Almondvale, so expect the area to be busier on matchdays. Edinburgh is a straightforward drive or train ride east if you're making a longer trip of it.
